board.why_january_does_not_move: June is at d = 5 from 2026-01, so it enters no January-head set. The January arm and december keep 47.55's reads exactly

disagreement_falsifier_47_44.note: 47.55 measured L = +0.0119 pooled over three folds and BOTH F1 and F2 fired. This is the july-only restatement at the five-month multiple, registered so the next read scores the same claim rather than a new one; the mechanism is already falsified on the rule as written

falsifiers.F_form: if the read sits closer to the additive companion than to the power-law point by more than july's 83.22 noise floor, the k = 5 form choice was wrong and 47.53's per-k rule takes the additive form at k = 5
falsifiers.F_gate: rule (a) on the read: july's five-month increment over v11's july arm must have an interval clear of zero. A negative or crossing interval FAILS the ruling's July head and v11 stands
falsifiers.F_input: if the read implies a June alone-value below the break-even 120.0, a d = 1 month did not carry its distance and the cross-fitted line's d = 1 point is falsified a second time
falsifiers.F_tie: the ruling itself is falsified if the five-month july read is BELOW the four-month read v11 ships: including a tied month would then have cost the fold it was included for

form_choice: 47.53's ruling names the form per k with the evidence for that k. July is the NEAR fold, where the power law was right to 1.6 % at k = 4 (+359.87 against a read of +354.35), so the power law leads here. The additive form is carried as the companion, not as the point, and both June inputs are carried because they differ by 189.32 s2/row against july's 83.22 noise floor

queue_observation.and_what_may_not_happen_next: a noise-aware tie-break would be a NEW parameter. If June's read disappoints, that parameter must be registered BEFORE it is used, never chosen after seeing which month it would drop
queue_observation.what_it_means_for_this_rule: a served-distance rule CANNOT see noise, by construction. That is exactly why no fold reading can pick a month, and it is also the risk being taken: the rule includes June whatever its spread
queue_observation.what_queue_says: 2025-06 is the hardest month built and its members agree most closely, a 14.7 s spread

ruling.december_reads_with: the January head (unserved, nearest Feb at d = 2)
ruling.form: a head's month set is EVERY built month at the MINIMUM served distance, ties included
ruling.registered_in: RESULTS.md 47.57, desk ruling, before any 2025-06 read
ruling.why_parameter_free: served distance is 47.30.1's, fixed by the calendar; the tie is broken by INCLUDING both, which needs no number. No fold reading picks a month

what: RESULTS section 47.57: the FIVE-month July head, registered BEFORE any 2025-06 read.
